description: Inserts a block of SILENCE into a sound at a given time, pushing the file apart (default) or overwriting it (-o). Pinned to submode 1 (time in seconds); submodes 2/3 take sample / grouped-sample counts. Duration model 'indur + duration - splice/1000' verified sample-exact in default mode (2 s + 0.5 s at 15 ms -> 2.4850 / 109588 frames; 1 s + 1 s -> 1.9850; -w0 -> 2.5000 exactly with the inserted zone EXACTLY zero and both flanks bit-equal to the source; -w100 -> 2.4). With -o the silence overwrites in place: 2 s stays 2.0000. END-PAD BUG (version-pinned): insertion at or within a splice of the file end mis-sizes the block - time 2.0 on a 2 s file exits 0 but outputs 4.0000 s (2.0 s of appended silence, not the requested 0.5); at 1.95 behavior is normal. Deterministic; mono and stereo accepted.
musical_use: Composed breathing room: push a phrase apart to insert a beat of rest, delay everything after a downbeat by an exact gap, or open a pocket for another element to answer into. Because the file physically lengthens (by duration minus one splice), downstream timings shift predictably - use splice 0 for exact arithmetic on a grid. The -o form is a timed mute instead: silence stamped over the material, length unchanged (like a one-region sfedit masks with scalar args). Splices at the silence's edges kill clicks; lengthen them to turn the gap into a dip-and-return. For many silences in one pass use manysil (which, unlike insil, consumes NO splice length); for silence at the start, prefix silence.

time.description: Time in the input where the silence is inserted. Runtime-enforced 0 to the input duration ('Parameter[1] Value (2.500000) out of range (0.000000 to 2.000000)') - but see the end-pad bug: keep time <= indur minus a splice. Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 1 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'). Required.

duration.description: Length of the inserted silence. 0 aborts 'Inserted silence is too short for splices.' (with splice 0 a zero-length insert is pointless anyway). Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 2 [...]'). Required.

splice.description: Splice window in milliseconds at the silence's edges (CDP internal default 15; enforced 0-5000). The output loses exactly one splice length overall (sample-exact at 0/15/100 ms). Must fit the silence ('Inserted silence is too short for splices.'). Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 3 [...]').

overwrite.description: Overwrite the original material with the silence instead of pushing the file apart (verified: duration stays exactly indur - a timed mute). The duration model covers the default push-apart mode only. If the overwritten zone would reach past the file end, CDP refuses 'Insertion will cut off entire end of file: use sfedit cut' unless -s is also set.

keep_end_silence.description: With -o, retain silence written over the file end instead of refusing: '-o -s' at time 1.8 + 0.5 s on a 2 s file warns 'Insertion will cut sound at end of file: leaving a silent section there.' and outputs 2.485 s. No effect in default mode.

examples.description: Push a phrase apart with half a second of rest.
examples.expected_use: Output = indur + 0.5 - 0.015 s (sample-exact); everything after 0.8 s shifts later.
Duration unchanged; the zone [0.8, 1.3] is overwritten with silence (splice 0 = exactly zero samples).

known_issues: END-PAD BUG (first-class, version-pinned): insertion at or within ~a splice of the file end mis-sizes the padding - time 2.0 (== indur) with duration 0.5 on a 2 s file exits 0 and outputs 4.0000 s (head bit-equal to the source, then 2.0 s of silence = INDUR, not the requested duration; time 1.99 -> 3.99 s). Normal at 1.95. Keep time <= indur - splice.
Duration model covers the default push-apart mode (sample-exact, one splice consumed). With overwrite=true output stays at indur (verified) - the model over-predicts there.
duration 0 (and any silence shorter than the splices) aborts 'Inserted silence is too short for splices.'.
-o near the file end refuses 'Insertion will cut off entire end of file: use sfedit cut' unless -s is passed (then a verbatim WARNING and exit 0).
All three numeric parameters reject breakpoint files ('Cannot read parameter N', N = 1-3). Deterministic; stereo verified with identical arithmetic.
DIVERGENCE from manysil: insil consumes one splice length from the total; manysil's insertions consume none.
